CustomField.description: Every order this code has been used on: paid card orders plus orders awaiting a check. This is the number the order form checks Max Redemptions against, and the one to read when asking how many people have used a code. Times Redeemed counts only what has been paid for, and a check order sits outside it for as long as the check is in the post.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Paid redemptions plus check orders awaiting payment. This is what the cap is measured against.
CustomField.label: Total Redemptions
